data.reason_zh: 系统将搜索规划交给可替换选择规则并以长期记忆数据库持久化每次尝试、由服务器反馈调控，但摘要未明确证明该改进对象本身被反馈改写并跨任务继承。

scope_support.feedback_quote: A server maintains the database and steers the agent after every submission, keeping it on course over long runs.
scope_support.object_quote: the selection rules of classical algorithms such as MAP-Elites and Monte Carlo tree search each reduce to a single query, which the agent is free to use, combine, or replace
scope_support.persistence_quote: This database serves as the agent's long-term memory
